section_header: FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Front Suspension
title: REPLACEMENT OF LOWER ARM DUST COVER and REPLACEMENT OF LOWER ARM BUSHING

content.text: REPLACEMENT OF LOWER ARM DUST COVER

content.description: Illustration showing hands removing dust cover set ring and dust cover from lower arm ball joint assembly

items.heading: REMOVE DUST COVER
items.text: Remove the dust cover set ring and dust cover.

content.description: Detailed cross-section diagram of dust cover assembly showing sections A and B, escape valve C, wire ends toward rear side of ball joint, and plug location
labels: Wire Ends toward Rear Side of Ball Joint

items.heading: INSTALL DUST COVER
steps: (a) Apply ball joint grease to section "A" and "B" of a new dust cover.
(b) Install the dust cover with the escape valve "C" facing the rear of car.
(c) Wind wire twice around the dust cover and bend the wire knot down.
(d) Remove the plug and install the grease fitting.

content.text:
Molybdenum Disulphide Lithium Base Grease:
NLGI No. 1 or No. 2

items: (f) Remove the grease fitting and install the plug.

content.description: Illustration showing SST (Special Service Tool) being used to press out bushing from lower arm

items.heading: REMOVE LOWER ARM BUSHING
items.text: Using SST, press out the bushing from the lower arm.

content.description: Illustration showing SST being used to press new bushing into lower arm

items.heading: INSTALL LOWER ARM BUSHING
items.text: Using SST, press the bushing into the lower arm.
